rubric_items.reason: Uses only existing modules and layers (route/service/repo, client.ts, todayIn, existing booking endpoints). It adds no new endpoint, table or infrastructure, and the DB exclusion constraints stay the guard.
The story mapping covers S-1 to S-6. Every AC (visibility, prefill, today in IST, no slot, reason carry-over and limit, inactive reasons, booking rules, regression) traces to a component or endpoint.

The EP-1 fields have name, type, nullability, format and example. But the type is a plain string, not the RecordStatus enum, and the example literal "Inactive" is unverified, so the ACs cannot test the exact value yet.
The EP-1 fields are marked known with example "Inactive", while Assumed says the stored literals are unconfirmed. Appointment status uses uppercase literals, so this guess is stated as fact.
The trade-offs cover the link vs a rebook endpoint, extending detail vs extra GETs, and the implicit vs explicit date, each with a reason.
Clear and well structured. There is a small inconsistency between the known EP-1 field status and the Assumed section.
